faostat-fs.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), FAOSTAT
faostat-fs.title: Suite of Food Security Indicators (July 2026 release, with The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2026)
faostat-fs.notes: Prevalence and number of undernourished people (modelled from food supply, consumption and dietary energy needs; country values are three-year averages, 2023–2025), and food insecurity measured with the Food Insecurity Experience Scale survey. CC BY 4.0.

faostat-cahd.publisher: FAO and World Bank, via FAOSTAT
faostat-cahd.title: Cost and Affordability of a Healthy Diet (July 2026 release)
faostat-cahd.notes: The cheapest locally available foods that meet healthy-diet guidelines, priced per person per day in 2021 international (PPP) dollars, and the share of people whose income, after other basic needs, can't cover it. 2025. CC BY 4.0.

faostat-cp.publisher: FAO, FAOSTAT, from national statistics offices, the IMF and the ILO
faostat-cp.title: Consumer Price Indices: food price inflation
faostat-cp.notes: Year-on-year change in each country's food consumer price index, by month. Latest month available for each country, mostly June 2026. CC BY 4.0.

fao-ffpi.title: FAO Food Price Index (November 2026 release)
fao-ffpi.notes: Monthly index of international prices for a basket of cereals, vegetable oils, dairy, meat and sugar, weighted by export shares. 2014–2016 = 100. Nominal, January 1990 to October 2026.

fao-ffpi-real.title: FAO Food Price Index, nominal and real, annual since 1961
fao-ffpi-real.notes: Annual averages. The real index is deflated by the World Bank's manufactures unit value index. 2026 is the average of January to October.

wb-pinksheet.title: Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), monthly prices
wb-pinksheet.notes: Nominal US dollars. Urea (Middle East), DAP, potassium chloride, wheat (US HRW), maize (US), rice (Thai 5%), palm oil, soybean oil and Brent crude. CC BY 4.0.

wb-fert-blog.publisher: World Bank Data Blog (John Baffes and Kaltrina Temaj)
wb-fert-blog.title: Fertilizer prices surge as Strait of Hormuz disruptions tighten supplies
wb-fert-blog.notes: From the April 2026 Commodity Markets Outlook.

fao-hormuz.title: Strait of Hormuz crisis: FAO Director-General outlines risks, actions and policy responses

sofi2026.publisher: FAO, IFAD, UNICEF, WFP and WHO
sofi2026.title: The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2026: launch press release

grfc2026.publisher: Global Network Against Food Crises and FSIN (reported by the European Commission Joint Research Centre)
grfc2026.title: Global Report on Food Crises 2026
grfc2026.notes: Acute food insecurity in 2025 in countries with food crises, classified with the IPC and Cadre Harmonisé scales. Phase 3 or above is Crisis, Emergency or Catastrophe.

ons-mm23.title: Consumer price inflation (MM23): series D7G8, D7G7 and D7BU
ons-mm23.notes: 12-month rate for food and non-alcoholic beverages (D7G8) and all items (D7G7), and the food price index (D7BU, 2015 = 100). Open Government Licence v3.0.

dwp-frs.title: Family Resources Survey: financial year 2024 to 2025
dwp-frs.notes: Official statistics. Household food security measured with the US Department of Agriculture's ten-question module. Open Government Licence v3.0.

ff-tracker.title: Food Insecurity Tracker, Round 19
ff-tracker.notes: Online YouGov survey of UK adults, June 2026. Measures food insecurity in the past month, so it runs higher than the yearly official figure.

usda-ers.publisher: USDA Economic Research Service (processed by Our World in Data)
usda-ers.title: Food as a share of total consumer expenditure
usda-ers.notes: Food eaten at home, as a share of all household consumer spending, 2023. Excludes restaurants, alcohol and tobacco.

natural-earth.title: Admin 0 countries, 1:110m
natural-earth.notes: Public domain. Used to match countries to map shapes.
